en: Black‑and‑white view of a long, grand colonnade with rows of Corinthian columns and ornate ceiling coffers and hanging lamps. People in early-20th-century clothing—men in long coats and bowler or top hats, women in long dresses and hats—stroll or sit along the corridor. The perspective looks through the colonnade toward large arched openings at the far end. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.
